comment: Shared between packages/shared/src/outlier.ts and programs/pumpking/src/outlier.rs. `distance` is the FR-011 rule and runs in TS only: the program never sees a reading. `share` is the FR-012 rule and runs on both sides, because T035 excludes on chain. Values are hundredths of a millimetre per interval; the constants are OUTLIER_FLOOR_X100 = 20, OUTLIER_REL_BPS = 5000, OUTLIER_SHARE_BPS = 2000, OUTLIER_MIN_JUDGED = 72.

distance.name: a dry hour, a sensor at the floor
a dry hour, one hundredth past the floor
light rain: the floor is wider than half the median
a downpour, exactly half the median off
a downpour, one hundredth past half
reporting a drought through a downpour
above the median counts the same as below
above the median, at the edge

share.name: every interval an outlier, but too few to judge
enough to judge, exactly at the threshold
enough to judge, one past the threshold
the minimum sample, a fifth exactly
the minimum sample, just over a fifth
a clean sensor over the whole window
a sensor gone bad in the second week
